name: ORCID
description: ORCID OAuth login/account-linking. SECURITY: the OAuth callback validates NO state → login-CSRF / forced account-linking → takeover, plus token/PII disclosure (danger 3). Do not deploy unpatched.
project_description:
“ORCID is an open, non-profit, community-driven effort to create and maintain a registry of unique researcher identifiers and a transparent method of linking research activities and outputs to these identifiers.” - ORCID.org 

 This module allows users to create account and login with ORCID OAuth2 .
